agency-os.why: You run client work and need to see every client, what you are doing for them, and what is slipping.
can: See every client’s health on one board
Link projects and tasks to the client they are for
Spot a client going quiet before they leave

client-portal.why: You want a client to approve work without the email back-and-forth.
can: Share one space with a client, and nothing else
Let the client approve each task or ask for changes
See what is waiting on the client at a glance

dev-project-os.why: You want the original dev setup: issues, sprints and releases in one space.
can: Sort new issues in a Triage inbox
Run lightweight sprints
Write release notes as you ship

content-engine.why: You publish articles and need to see what is an idea, being written, in edit or ready.
can: Move each article through its stages on a board
Group articles into topic clusters
Plan campaigns around what is ready to go

book-launch.why: You are writing a book and planning its launch.
can: Track every chapter from outline to final
Keep research notes next to the chapter they belong to
Plan launch tasks and appearances on one list

coaching-os.why: You coach people through programs and regular sessions.
can: See every session on a calendar
Know which client is in which program
Keep the action items each session produces

consulting-os.why: You sell consulting work and then deliver it.
can: Track proposals from draft to won or lost
Watch hours against each engagement’s budget
Turn a won proposal into delivery tasks

social-command-center.why: You post on LinkedIn or X and want plans, replies and results in one place.
can: Plan posts on a calendar
Sort replies on a board so none are missed
Log how each post performed

support-inbox.why: People send you problems and you need to make sure none get lost.
can: Move every ticket from New to Done on a board
Get told when a ticket’s status changes
Let the Triage agent suggest a type and priority

team-board.why: Your team needs one place to see who is doing what this week.
can: Drag a task from To Do to Done, and everyone sees it move
Open “Assigned to me” to see only your own work
Assign a task and the person is told straight away

team-wiki.why: Your team keeps answering the same questions, or nobody knows which document is still true.
can: Give every page an owner people can ask
See which pages nobody has checked in 90 days
Send new starters to Onboarding instead of answering in chat

dev-tracker.why: You build software and want bugs and features in one queue, next to the rest of your work.
can: Drop in a bug and it lands in Triage for someone to sort
Put issues into projects and sprints, the way Linear does
Ship a release, and its page becomes the changelog
